blocks.title: Safety reading
blocks.content:
Under the Wound Dressing profile, this construct clears every assessed gate but sits close to one.
Toxicity (ToxinPred3) measures 0.350 against a threshold of 0.380 from the predictor's own cut-off, which is at or below the limit. The value sits within ten percent of the threshold.
Haemolysis (HemoPI2) measures 0.189 against a threshold of 0.550 from the predictor's own cut-off, which is at or below the limit.
Immunogenicity (MHC-I) (MHCflurry 2.0) measures 0.000 against a threshold of 0.350 from the route's screening profile, which is at or below the limit.
Soft signals, which do not veto: B-cell epitope (soft) 0.268 (threshold 0.151).

blocks.title: Peptide origin and composition
blocks.content:
The peptide is 12 residues, drawn from legacy_pdb_2022 (dataset version 2022-09-28).
Composition: 3 hydrophobic residues (25%), 0 charged (0%), 0 aromatic (0%).
No cysteine residues, so the peptide has no disulfide-mediated structural constraint.
One-dimensional AGGRESCAN gives -0.259, below zero, which indicates a low intrinsic aggregation propensity. The scale is a mean per-residue aggregation score, negative for aggregation-averse sequences.
The direction's functional score is 0.426, produced by AnOxPePred (FRS head).

blocks.title: Linker and assembly
blocks.content:
The linker is GGGGS, 5 residues long, classified as Flexible.
A glycine-serine linker of this kind gives the fused peptide rotational freedom and separates it from the scaffold surface, which matters when the functional epitope would otherwise be masked by the scaffold. The trade-off is that the unstructured segment is more exposed to proteases.
The linker sequence recorded here comes from the sample linker table rather than the curated library, and the construct carries no verified linker choice: the assembly step that produced it picked the first available row.
The construct's stored scaffold binding is `placeholder`. No fused sequence is emitted, because the bound scaffold row holds a marker string rather than a real sequence.

blocks.title: Expression and handling
blocks.content:
No expression host, vector or induction condition is recorded against this construct. The dataset does not carry that field, so nothing is asserted here.
Predicted solubility is 0.241 (SoDoPE). Recombinant yield is the practical constraint that this score stands in for: a low value typically means the construct partitions into inclusion bodies and needs refolding rather than a straightforward soluble purification.
Predicted thermal stability is 0.364 (TemStaPro), relevant to storage and to any formulation step that involves heating.
